title: Harvest and Visitor
author: Vesper Sterling
blurb: Odile Delacroix, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
